picks.thesis: AAPL demonstrates consistent revenue growth and strong free cash flow generation, trading at a reasonable P/E of ~30x. Recent pullback to 50-day moving average presents a quality-growth entry with improving services segment momentum and iPhone 15 cycle tailwinds.

CRM shows improving cloud revenue growth (25% YoY) and expanding operating margins (20%+). Recent AI integrations (Einstein GPT) position it well for enterprise adoption. Valuation at ~7x EV/Sales is reasonable for this growth profile, with technical support at $240.

TSLA faces margin compression (gross margins down to 17.6%) and slowing demand (Q2 deliveries missed estimates). Price cuts erode brand premium while competition intensifies. Technical breakdown below $180 confirms bearish momentum with RSI divergence on weekly charts.

INJ forming a bullish flag pattern on the 4h chart after a strong uptrend. Volume contraction during consolidation suggests accumulation, with a breakout target near prior highs. RSI (14) neutral (~55) and MACD histogram turning positive support momentum continuation.

SOL rejected at key resistance (~$155) with a bearish engulfing candle on the daily chart. Volume spike on the rejection confirms selling pressure. 4h RSI (14) overbought (>70) and diverging from price, suggesting a pullback to the 50-day EMA (~$138) is likely. Break below $148 would confirm the reversal.
MVST trending on Reddit/WSB with rising volume and call option activity. Recent consolidation near $2.00 support with short interest >25% suggests potential gamma squeeze. Retail momentum building.

MARA showing strong retail call buying with dealers short gamma. Bitcoin correlation remains high, and recent breakout above $18 resistance suggests upward delta hedging flow. High short interest (>30%) adds squeeze potential.

GSAT overbought after recent 50% run-up with declining volume. Retail sentiment extremely bullish (Reddit/WSB mentions spiking), but RSI >75 and no clear catalyst. Short interest low (<10%), but weak technicals suggest mean reversion likely.

ASTS breaking out of month-long consolidation with surging retail call volume. SpaceX partnership rumors circulating on Twitter/StockTwits, and short interest >20% suggests potential short squeeze. Dealers long gamma, reducing downside risk.
